extracted.intended_audience: Central Intelligence Group / CIA personnel responsible for records, message centers, couriers, and distribution of incoming and outgoing written communications
extracted.subtask_description: Administrative procedure for handling incoming and outgoing written material for the Central Intelligence Group, covering Central Registry duties, filing systems, office message centers, courier operations, addressing, file-card practice, and distribution of intelligence reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Central Registry Section responsibilities
rubrics_metrics.description: The Central Registry Section under the Communications Division shall receive and dispatch all incoming and outgoing material except cables; will classify for read/reference for filing all incoming and outgoing material; will maintain files on all material, except intelligence information; and will provide officer and enlisted courier service for C.I.G.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original wording: "The Central Registry Section . . . will receive and dispatch all incoming and outgoing material for except cables; will classify for read/reference for filing all incoming and outgoing material; will maintain files on all material, except intelligence information; and will provide officer and enlisted courier service for C.I.G." This establishes the Registry as the central point for non-cable/non-intelligence routing, classification, filing, and courier provision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establish uniform filing system (File Classification System)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Central Registry Section shall establish a uniform filing system for the information and guidance of all offices of C.I.G. in the filing of material other than cables and intelligence information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original wording: "The Central Registry Section will publish and distribute the procedures for the establishment of such a system to be called the File Classification System." Guidance implies mandatory adoption across offices for non-cable/non-intelligence records; the Registry publishes and distributes the procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Office and staff message centers requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Each office of C.I.G. and appropriate staff branches and divisions shall maintain Message Centers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original wording: "The organization and functioning of these Message Centers will be under the direction of Assistant Directors for their offices and of heads of appropriate staff echelons." Responsibility for organization and operation rests with the respective Assistant Directors and staff heads.

rubrics_metrics.name: Secure couriers and courier scheduling
rubrics_metrics.description: The Central Registry Section shall provide secure couriers for the handling of communications and other papers between the Office- and Staff Message Centers, and between C.I.G. and certain outside agencies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original wording: "The Central Registry will inform all concerned of the schedules on which these couriers operate." The Registry must publicize courier schedules. The development of intra-office delivery systems is left to the discretion of office and staff heads: "The development of the system for the delivery of papers within the offices and staff echelons of C.I.G. is left to the discretion of office and staff heads concerned."

rubrics_metrics.name: Addressing incoming material
rubrics_metrics.description: Incoming material for the Central Intelligence Group must be addressed using the prescribed format (Central Intelligence Group; (Name of activity); room and departmental identifiers; Washington, D.C. postal details).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page provides an addressing example: "Central Intelligence Group (Name of activity) Room 216 [department/office id] Washington 25, D. C." Use the prescribed address format so mail is routed correctly to Central Registry/office.

rubrics_metrics.name: File Card handling and CIG Control Number filing
rubrics_metrics.description: File Cards will be filed in numerical sequence by CIG Control Number. For certain offices (e.g., Office Message Center of the Office of Research and Evaluation) additional copies are furnished and separate filing by Source is maintained.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original wording and procedure: "The File Card will then be filed in numerical sequence by CIG Control Number. In the case of the Office Message Center of the Office of Research and Evaluation two additional copies of the card are furnished. In addition to the CIG Control Number file, that office will file one copy of the form by Source; the third copy will be attached to the copy of the document which is forwarded to the Intelligence Library... Upon receipt in the Library of ORS this copy of the form will be removed when the basic Intelligence Library file Classification has been determined for the report. This classification will be written over the face of the third copy of the File Card and returned through the Office Message Center to Central Registry, where a notation on the CIG Control Number Card will be made of the ORS classification." Follow the three-copy process, library routing, and notation requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outgoing intelligence reports — dissemination orders
rubrics_metrics.description: The Office of Collection and Dissemination shall furnish the Special Distribution Unit or the Distribution Unit a dissemination Order covering the dissemination of each C.I. publication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original wording: "Office of Collection and Dissemination will furnish the Special Distribution Unit or the Distribution Unit a dissemination Order covering the dissemination of each C.I. publication." Ensures that each intelligence publication has an explicit dissemination order before distribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outgoing intelligence reports — forwarding and automatic distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Prior to publication all copies of the report will be forwarded to the Special Distribution Unit or Distribution Unit, depending upon the classification of the report, where distribution will be made automatically according to the dissemination orders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original wording: "If to publication all copies of the report will be forwarded to Special Distribution Unit or Distribution Unit, depending upon the classification of the report, where distribution will be made automatically according to the dissemination orders." Requires forwarding all report copies to the appropriate distribution unit for automatic dissemination per the dissemination orders.
